question: Which of the following states became the first to launch the Tribal Genome Sequencing Project in July 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **July 2025**, the state of **Gujarat** became the first in **India** to officially launch a specialized **Tribal Genome Sequencing Project** to study the genetic diversity of its indigenous populations.
 
• The project is a landmark initiative by the **Government of Gujarat**, aimed at creating a comprehensive genetic database of the various tribal groups living within the state.
 
• A primary objective of the **Tribal Genome Sequencing Project** is to identify genetic markers for diseases that disproportionately affect tribal communities, such as **Sickle Cell Anemia** and **G6PD deficiency**.
 
• The **Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre (GBRC)**, an autonomous institute under the **Department of Science and Technology**, is the lead agency responsible for the execution and data analysis of this project.
